evidence: T-0047 implements Goal #30 P1.4.3 and P1.4.4 only.
.shiki/schemas/cca-evidence-manifest.schema.json defines the workflow-generated CCA evidence manifest contract.
.github/workflows/shiki-cca-completion.yml builds .shiki/gha/cca-evidence-manifest.json after CCA verdict enforcement and CCA Review Bridge, before uploading shiki-cca-evidence.
scripts/shiki_evidence.py and scripts/build_cca_evidence_manifest.py generate manifest metadata and SHA-256 digests for required CCA evidence files.
scripts/mergegate_check.py validates the downloaded manifest against live PR repository, PR number, head SHA, task id, goal id, verdict metadata, and required evidence file digests.
Ledger evidence_refs and ledger_integrity are validated when present while historical ledger entries without evidence_refs remain valid.
scripts/validate_shiki.py validates evidence integrity wiring, manifest schema, docs, template coverage, ledger refs, and digest fixtures.
scripts/shiki_doctor.py reports evidence manifest wiring as doctor.evidence_integrity.manifest.
scripts/test_shiki_evidence_integrity.sh covers manifest generation, mismatch failures, digest mismatch, missing manifest, MergeGate integration, workflow static checks, and ledger evidence_refs.
docs/agents/evidence-integrity.md documents workflow-generated CCA evidence, PR-authored .shiki/gha distrust, ledger evidence_refs, and the non-signing boundary.
PR #91 records T-0047 implementation review and CCA/MergeGate evidence.
Required skills were used: diagnose, tdd, improve-codebase-architecture.

Non-goals preserved: P1.4.5, P1.4.6, P2, external signing, Guardian policy changes, CCA Review Bridge changes, branch protection, CODEOWNERS, runtime adapter, migration redesign, and Node workflow compatibility work.
summary: Implemented CCA evidence manifest and ledger evidence reference hardening for T-0047.
